claim: For all integer d>=3 and q>=3, the critical monochromatic Gibbs state of the nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic q-state Potts model on Z^d has mu^i_{beta_c}(sigma_0=i)>1/q.
assumptions: zero field; nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic interaction; integer spin colors q>=3; d>=3; infinite-volume monochromatic-boundary state at its own critical inverse temperature
source: Duminil-Copin et al., Continuity of the phase transition for planar Potts models, pp. 3-4, https://www.unige.ch/~duminil/publi/pottsPhaseTransition.pdf ; intake ranking row 541
source_quote: In dimension d >= 3, the phase transition is expected to be continuous if and only if q = 2.
proof_or_counterexample: This is the source-scoped conjecture, not a proof. The same source specifies critical magnetization as the discontinuity criterion and records only high-d or high-q proven regimes.
remaining_gap: Establish positive ordered magnetization at beta_c for all currently uncovered finite (d,q), especially (3,3); verify current literature and owner's prior solved/retired status.
audit_verdict: FIX intake title by specifying the ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor zero-field model, integer q, the beta_c criterion, and the already-proven regimes.

claim: For the free FK model on a triangle with q=3 and p=1/2, two distinct edge-open events A,B have P(A)=P(B)=3/11 and P(A and B)=1/11>9/121=P(A)P(B). Thus disjoint edge sets do not justify multiplying their unconditional crossing marginals.
assumptions: triangle graph; free boundary; q=3; p=1/2; A,B concern two different single edges
source_quote: Eight edge configurations have weights 3^k; the total is 66, a one-edge numerator is 18, and the two-edge numerator is 6.

assumptions: 2017 Potts q is an integer number of colors; 2018 FK q can be real; q_c is interpreted as a real threshold
source: w462-C0048-Q1; intake problems.jsonl:48; read-only live C0048 card claim_38c945c83e6d9f9dc77b20f936b660e811e528c284f76bd513990e6ed06ecc6a; H. Duminil-Copin, arXiv:1712.04651, PDF pp.6,17
